token_introduction.name: Menahi Token
token_introduction.description: Menahi is a modern ERC20/TRC20 token built on the TRON blockchain with advanced features including mint/burn capabilities, blacklist management, and dynamic metadata. Designed for flexibility and security, Menahi provides a robust foundation for token-based applications.
token_introduction.overview: Menahi Token is a sophisticated blockchain token engineered to provide stability through its 1:1 USDT peg while maintaining advanced smart contract functionality. With a total supply of 1,000,000 tokens (1 MNH with 6 decimals), Menahi offers a secure, transparent, and feature-rich ecosystem.
key_features: 1:1 USDT Peg - Stable value pegged to USDT
Blacklist Management - Owner can manage restricted addresses
Dynamic Metadata - Changeable name, symbol, and logo
Logo URL Support - Integrated logo management
Ownership Transfer - Secure transfer of contract ownership
Gas Efficient - Optimized for minimal gas consumption

smart_contract_functions.transfer: Transfer tokens to any address (subject to blacklist)
smart_contract_functions.approve: Approve a spender to use your tokens
smart_contract_functions.mint: Owner function to create new tokens
smart_contract_functions.burn: Burn tokens from your balance (permanently remove)
smart_contract_functions.blacklist: Owner function to blacklist an address
smart_contract_functions.unBlacklist: Owner function to remove address from blacklist
smart_contract_functions.transferOwnership: Transfer contract ownership to new address

use_cases: Stablecoin Alternative - 1:1 USDT peg for stable value transactions
Payment Token - Direct peer-to-peer transfers on TRON network
Governance Token - Basis for DAO or governance applications
Liquidity Pool - Integration with DEXs and AMMs
Token Rewards - Distribution mechanism for applications
security_features: Blacklist Protection - Prevent malicious addresses from transferring
Owner Controls - Mint, burn, and blacklist management
Standard Compliance - Full ERC20/TRC20 standard adherence
Immutable Decimals - Cannot be changed after deployment

how_to_use.step1: Deploy contract on TRON network using your Solidity compiler
how_to_use.step2: Update contract address in token-info.json and token-price.json
how_to_use.step3: Add token to TRON wallets using the contract address
how_to_use.step4: Start transacting MNH tokens on TRON network
how_to_use.step5: Use owner functions for mint, burn, and blacklist management

token_introduction.disclaimer: Menahi Token is provided as-is. Users should conduct their own due diligence before transacting. The token creator is not responsible for losses or damages resulting from token usage.
